elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One to provide transition assistance to Corio.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees assistance only for at least 90 days; it does not require availability throughout a six-month transition period.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 does not state any rate or payment basis for transition assistance.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Corio or its Customers.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires export and delivery but does not expressly require a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) expressly requires export and delivery within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must certify its deletion.
elements.evidence: Neither Section 11.4 nor the existing return-or-destroy provision requires Commerce One to delete the exported data thereafter or provide a deletion certification.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One to provide transition assistance to Corio.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided for 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(a) requires transition assistance for at least 90 days following expiration or termination.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export and deliver Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) requires Commerce One to export and deliver to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Corio or its Customers.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported and delivered within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4(b) expressly imposes a 30-day deadline after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline fully reaches the fallback by requiring at least 90 days of transition assistance and data export and delivery within 30 days. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks a six-month assistance commitment, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, and deletion certification. The addition is targeted and does not disturb the existing survival, support, payment, or confidentiality provisions, though “at least ninety days” lacks a definite endpoint and “transition assistance” is undefined.
